objects.name: Critical GiveWP Flaw Lets Attackers Run Commands on WordPress Servers
objects.description: A critical GiveWP flaw lets unauthenticated attackers execute server commands. A critical vulnerability in GiveWP, one of the most widely used WordPress plugins for online donations and fundraising, can let an unauthenticated attacker execute commands on the server.
